methodology.distance: WGS84 ellipsoidal geodesics. Nearest point on Census Texas polygon in a base-centered azimuthal equidistant projection. Boundary is generalized; near-threshold cases need exact-site review.
methodology.limitations: Not a dispatch tool, operational coverage guarantee, aircraft range limit, response-time model or membership coverage map. Seven user-provided roster excerpts were received October 20, 2026; their effective date and completeness are not established. Listed phones are transcribed, not independently dial-verified or asserted to be dispatch numbers. Owner confirmations are identified; approximate coordinates are not surveyed launch points.
